additional_info.subject: ID0374481-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2 / R7 313065117151] Blackscreen issue CRM:00642001410
additional_info.body:
Hello ﻿Yunus,﻿
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Mohini
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
Y2 / R7 313065117151
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
6uuIW9
Problem Description
: Blackscreen issue
Troubleshooting
:
Regarding the reported issue of a black terminal screen, please take the following action on your end, as it will assist in resolving the problem.
1.
Please reboot the charger.
1. The DP cable needs to be replaced. Use a new 1.5m cable (Official Siemens spare part only, no other brands), and ensure it is routed as far away from routers as possible to avoid EMC performance issues, as identified by R&D.
2. Verify the 24VDC power supply is set to 25VDC.
3. Additionally, check whether the LED strips are faulty.
For future reference, your ticket number is
0374481
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Mohini Patil
